relations.boundary: Local geophysical evidence is environmental context or a null model, not background-cosmology evidence.

invariants: Twins artwork != seismometer or direct solid-Earth vibration detector
bulk quartz SiO2 != bulk source of hydrogen or water
fluid inclusions or OH defects in quartz != water manufactured from pure silica
Hamza regional porous flow != a channelized underground river larger than the Amazon
optical or radio fracture emission != demonstrated X-ray emission
larger rocky planet != linear amplification of quartz piezoelectric output
a non-empty winner requires preregistration, uncertainty, baselines, falsifiers and raw-data hashes
source registries include counterevidence and claim limits
TOKEN_VAZIO is not converted to zero or PASS
missing_real_experiment: synchronized mechanical, acoustic, electric and magnetic channels
energy-resolved radiation detector with calibration and background control
porosity, permeability and fluid chemistry for hydrology tests

next_gate.exit_criteria: One reproducible synchronized ground-vibration experiment with quartz-bearing and quartz-free controls, calibrated multisensor data, radiation spectrum, uncertainties and hashes.
